item.title: IBROX MEN ‘GOT WHAT THEY DESERVED,’ INSISTS SUTTON
item.description: FORMER Celtic goal hero Chris Sutton believes Danny Ruhl’s Ibrox side got what they DESERVED when they dropped two points in the 1-1 stalemate at Fir Park in midweek. item.title: NICOLSON IN CHARGE
item.description: DUNCAN NICOLSON will be in charge of Celtic’s crucial Premiership encounter with Kilmarnock at Rugby Park on Sunday afternoon. He will be assisted by Scott Anderson and Alastair Taylor on the touchlines while Greg Aitken will be at the VAR controls. Nicolson was match official at the champions’ 1-0 triumph over Dundee at Parkhead on December 3 [...]

item.description: CELTIC were within three seconds of going out of the Scottish Cup before Junior Adamu struck with the equaliser against Dundee at Parkhead on Saturday. item.description: CHRIS SUTTON has opened fire on Reo Hatate who has hardly turned up for Celtic this season.
